title: The composition and timing of flower odour emission by wild Petunia axillaris coincide with the antennal perception and nocturnal activity of the pollinator Manduca sexta
why: Benzenoid emission of Petunia axillaris shows a circadian rhythm peaking at night; the abstract sentence is 124 characters but the abstract says the traits held across subspecies and accessions, and no constant-condition test is stated, so the full text should say which accession carried the rhythm.
